subjects.name: City College of New York stampede
East Coast-West Coast hip hop rivalry

summary: Hip hop mogul Sean "Diddy" Combs built Bad Boy Records and a celebrity empire in New York while allegedly drugging, raping and trafficking adults and minors from 1991 onward, until his federal arrest in 2024.

evidence.note: birth in Harlem in 1969 opens the biography
1991 charity basketball game he promoted ends in a deadly crush at City College
earliest drugging and rape allegation dated to 1991
allegations of raping two girls aged 15 and 16 around 1993-94
1994 allegation of dating abuse, beatings and forced drug use
founding of Bad Boy and the rivalry with Death Row
Keefe D claims of a bounty on Tupac; Biggie killed 1997
freak-off parties and a contest winner drugged at one
2023 suit by an eleventh-grader alleging gang rape
Cassie Ventura lawsuit describing years of beatings and coercion
September 2024 arrest and denial of bail close the story

notes: Covered span runs to 2024 (his arrest, the last event at release). Roles are judgement calls: the story treats him as a label mogul first and performer second. The taxonomy has no theme for organized-crime killings or crowd disasters, so the rap-war murders and the 1991 crush live only in subjects. drugs is secondary for the systematic drugging of victims and the narcotics at the parties.
